description: This file defines the 'FilteredTopic' interface, which wraps a 'Topic' and an optional filter string (RQL query) to filter signals based on their namespace and filters, and provides methods for retrieving associated topic details, filter information, extra field selectors, and string representation.

classes.name: FilteredTopic
classes.description: An interface representing a topic with optional filtering and extra field selection capabilities, used for filtering signals based on criteria such as namespaces and RQL filter strings.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns the Topic associated with this FilteredTopic.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns the list of namespaces for which the filter applies; if empty, the filter applies to all namespaces.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the filter string as an RQL query, or empty if no filter is set.

methods.name: hasFilter
methods.description: Deprecated method that indicates whether a filter is present; recommended to use getFilter().isPresent().

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional with a JsonFieldSelector for enriching outgoing signals with extra fields, or empty if no enrichment is specified.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the FilteredTopic.
